meta: Corner grocery stores use AI to order stock, track credit and arrange shelves: no more running out of bestsellers or overstocking slow items.

muc.title: Everything in the owner's head
muc.text: Corner stores run out of bestsellers and overstock slow items, because everything lives only in the owner's head.

muc.title: An order list
muc.text: Copy last week's sales into a chatbot, an AI chat assistant, and ask it to make an order list.

muc.title: A tidy credit book
muc.text: Ask AI for a credit book template: date, item, amount, payback date. Use nicknames only; don't paste customers' phone numbers.

muc.title: What goes where
muc.text: Describe your items and shop size and ask AI how to arrange shelves: popular items at eye level, heavy items low.

muc.title: A top-ten table
muc.text: Ask a chatbot for a table of your ten bestsellers with a stock column to count each evening.
